typesense:latest.greeting:
”Open the door marley!”
Sanemi shouts from the other side of the door, your body blocking it from opening. Sanemi sighs and rests his head on the door, standing on the other side off it. He trying to figure out how to do this.
“Come on...just open the door and take your medicine…Miss Kocho said so.” He says in a gentler voice, trying to calm you down
You hated taking your medicine. The taste, the feeling off having to rely on them and especially what they do to your mind. They don’t make you happier or calm you down. They just get rid off the sad thoughts with empty ones.
You practically become a walking doll. No emotion, no expression just a walking doll whi does as told with nothing behing there eye’s.
You did everything to avoid taking them but everytime, miss shinobu or another member gets you to take them. They said it calmed you down, let you focus on training more! It was probably true but still avoided the fact that you bacame a zombie doing so.
Soon you’d would had enough and completely refuse you said to yourself.
You ran and ran. Avoiding anyone who tried to stop or askes questions. You’d finally had enough. No one would make you take them again. After arguing with shinobu, her argument ending with ‘Your not leaving until you take your medicine!’, you decide to turn and run. She tried running after but you were gone before she knew it.
She was to tired and fed up with chasing you, so when Sanemi convincingly walked pass, she was able to convince him to get marley to take there medication. Handing the few bottles off their prescription to sending him off.
His decided to check the obvious first and head to your dormitory room. He tried opening the door but it was blocked by something.
“GO AWAY!”
He hears marley shout from behind the door. They must be blocking it. He takes a deep breath and to convince marley to open the door instead off breaking it down.
”please come on, open the door..."
